With this new position, I could afford to go out a lot and was getting a lot of attention from my "cool" bosses, women and peers. I still regret my lack of conviction, but now don't beat myself up so much about it, just try to move forward.

One of the lessons I can learn from this is that avoidance can work for a while, but not if you've nowhere to find solace.
